description: Retrieve cross-database references for a gene or feature — HGNC, UniProt, EntrezGene, OMIM, RefSeq, Reactome, and others. Returns each xref with its database name, primary ID, display ID, and description, plus how Ensembl assigned it (infoType, infoText) and its evidence codes (linkageTypes, such as GO evidence codes) when supplied. By default only the requested object level is queried; all_levels=true includes transcript and translation references for a gene. The dbname filter narrows this scope. IDs returned here chain onward: a Uniprot/SWISSPROT accession to UniProt (protein function) and PubChem (bioassays against the protein), MIM_GENE to OMIM (disease), Reactome_gene and Reactome to Reactome (pathways), and PDB to structure sources. Requires an Ensembl stable ID — use ensembl_lookup_gene to get the ENSG… ID first. Common dbname values: HGNC, Uniprot_gn, Uniprot/SWISSPROT (reviewed UniProt accession, held on the translation: use all_levels=true from a gene or transcript), EntrezGene, MIM_GENE, RefSeq_mRNA, RefSeq_peptide, Reactome_gene (gene pathways), Reactome (translation pathways), GO (Gene Ontology), ChEMBL.

all_levels.description: Include references on child objects: a gene includes its transcripts and translations. Default false queries only the requested object level, independently of dbname.

dbname.description: Filter to a specific external database by its Ensembl internal name. Examples: HGNC (HGNC gene ID), Uniprot_gn (UniProt gene name), Uniprot/SWISSPROT (reviewed UniProt accession, on the translation), EntrezGene (NCBI Gene ID), MIM_GENE (OMIM disease gene), RefSeq_mRNA (NCBI RefSeq transcript), Reactome_gene (gene pathways), Reactome (translation pathways), GO (Gene Ontology terms). Transcript/translation references may require all_levels=true or the specific feature ID. Omit to return every database within the selected scope.

id.description: Ensembl stable gene (ENSG…), transcript (ENST…), or translation (ENSP…) ID. A version suffix on an ENS… ID (ENSG00000139618.17) is dropped before the request. Use ensembl_lookup_gene to get the stable ID from a gene symbol. References default to this object level; all_levels=true includes child objects.

name: ensembl_get_xrefs

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The Ensembl stable ID was not found. An empty cross-reference list remains successful. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no cross-references are found.

queriedId.description: The Ensembl stable ID as submitted, including any version suffix.

xrefs.description: Cross-database references for the queried Ensembl ID.

items.description: A single cross-database reference entry with database name, primary ID, and description.

dbname.description: Database name in Ensembl internal format (e.g. HGNC, Uniprot_gn, Uniprot/SWISSPROT, EntrezGene, MIM_GENE, RefSeq_mRNA).

displayId.description: Display identifier — often the same as primaryId but may be a formatted accession.

infoText.description: Detail Ensembl records for the assignment: its source (e.g. UniProt, GO_Central) or, for a projection, the ortholog it came from. Omitted when blank.

infoType.description: How Ensembl assigned the reference, e.g. DIRECT (from the external database), DEPENDENT (derived from another reference), PROJECTION (projected from an ortholog), SEQUENCE_MATCH, CHECKSUM.

linkageTypes.description: Evidence codes supporting the reference — GO evidence codes on GO terms (e.g. IDA experimental, IEA electronic, ISS sequence similarity). Omitted when Ensembl lists none.

primaryId.description: Primary identifier in the external database (e.g. HGNC:1101 for BRCA2 in HGNC, P51587 for BRCA2 in UniProt).

title: Get Cross-Database References
